name: augmeter
description: Track local Claude Code, Codex, and GitHub Copilot activity alongside connected Augment credits in VS Code.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Augmeter disables local coding-assistant and session-history tracking in untrusted workspaces.

augmeter.providers.enabled.description: Track local activity from selected coding assistants in the tooltip, assistant usage view, and exports. Local reading is off in untrusted workspaces.

augmeter.providers.enabledIds.description: Choose which coding assistants Augmeter tracks locally. Augment credit collection is configured separately.

augmeter.providers.targets.description: Set optional monthly activity targets by assistant. Claude Code and Codex values are local user turns; Copilot values are requests. Example: { "claude": 1200, "codex": 900, "copilot": 1500 }.

augmeter.providers.alerts.description: Advanced: override activity-target alerts by assistant. Example: { "claude": { "warningPercent": 70, "highPercent": 85, "criticalPercent": 95, "runOutDays": 2 } }.

augmeter.providers.claude.path.description: Override the local Claude Code log path. Leave blank to use ~/.claude/projects.

augmeter.providers.codex.path.description: Override the local Codex session path. Leave blank to use ~/.codex/sessions.

augmeter.providers.copilot.stateDbPath.description: Override the VS Code database used for local Copilot request counts. Leave blank to use the platform default.

augmeter.providers.copilot.api.enabled.description: Read official Copilot premium-request usage from GitHub. Uses the token environment variable below and falls back to local VS Code counts if unavailable.

augmeter.providers.copilot.api.username.description: GitHub username whose Copilot premium-request usage Augmeter should read.

augmeter.providers.copilot.api.tokenEnvV.description: Name of the environment variable containing the GitHub token. Augmeter reads the token at runtime and does not store it.

augmeter.providers.copilot.api.baseUrl.description: GitHub API base URL. Keep the default for github.com.

augmeter.providers.copilot.api.timeoutMs.description: Advanced: stop a GitHub usage request after this many milliseconds.

enumDescriptions: Prefer the Auggie CLI when installed and signed in; fall back to the session cookie.
Only use the Auggie CLI (auggie account status).
Only use a session cookie stored in VS Code SecretStorage.
augmeter.dataSource.description: Choose how Augmeter reads Augment credits.

augmeter.auggieCli.path.description: Override the Auggie CLI path. Augmeter runs this binary to read credit information, so choose only a trusted installation. Leave blank to detect it automatically.

augmeter.apiBaseUrl.description: Advanced: Augment API base URL. Change only for a known Augment environment.

augmeter.history.retentionDays.description: Keep local Augment credit history for trends and CSV exports (7-90 days).

augmeter.alerts.warningPercent.description: Notify when Augment credit use reaches this warning threshold.

augmeter.alerts.highPercent.description: Notify when Augment credit use reaches this high threshold.

augmeter.alerts.criticalPercent.description: Notify when Augment credit use reaches this critical threshold.

augmeter.alerts.runOutDays.description: Warn when Augment credits may run out within this many days. Use 0 to turn off this alert.

augmeter.budget.cycleTarget.description: Set a personal credit target for the current Augment billing cycle. Use 0 to turn off target tracking.

augmeter.budget.monthlyTarget.deprecationMessage: Use augmeter.budget.cycleTarget. Existing values continue to work until you set the new option.

augmeter.sessionTracking.enabled.description: Experimental: show today's Augment prompts and sessions from local Augment logs.

augmeter.sessionTracking.path.description: Experimental: override the local Augment sessions path. Leave blank to use ~/.augment/sessions.

augmeter.smartSignIn.quickWatchMs.description: Advanced: clipboard watch time before opening Augment, in milliseconds. Use 0 to skip this step.

augmeter.smartSignIn.websiteWatchMs.description: Advanced: clipboard watch time after opening Augment, in milliseconds.

augmeter.clickAction.description: Choose what happens when you click connected Augment credit data in the status bar. When Augment is disconnected, clicking opens Assistant usage.

enumDescriptions: Show credits used and the cycle limit (for example, 55/100).
Show credits left and the cycle limit (for example, 45/100).
Show used, limit, and credits left (for example, 55/100 · 45 left).
Show percent of cycle credits used (for example, 55%).
augmeter.displayMode.description: Choose which Augment credit values appear in the status bar.

enumDescriptions: Show an icon when the value is short; use text only for longer values.
Always show an icon with the value.
augmeter.statusBarDensity.description: Choose whether the status-bar meter includes an icon. Compact mode also hides the Augment label.

augmeter.statusBarIcon.description: Choose the icon shown in Detailed or eligible Auto mode.

augmeter.showPercentInStatusBar.description: Add percent used to non-percentage status-bar modes.

augmeter.colorScheme.description: Choose how early the status-bar color changes as Augment credits are used.

augmeter.colorThresholds.description: Set custom status-bar color thresholds by percent of Augment credits used.

augmeter.enhancedReadability.description: Use colored backgrounds as well as text so status changes are easier to spot.

augmeter.autoDetectHighContrast.description: Match status colors to VS Code high-contrast themes.

augmeter.showInStatusBar.description: Show Augmeter in the VS Code status bar.

augmeter.enabled.description: Track selected coding assistants and, when connected, Augment credits.

augmeter.refreshInterval.description: Refresh assistant activity and connected usage at this interval while VS Code is focused (1-300 seconds).

augmeter.backgroundMultiplier.description: Refresh less often while VS Code is in the background. For example, 5 turns a 60-second interval into 5 minutes. Use 1 for no slowdown.

augmeter.logLevel.description: Log detail shown in Output > Augmeter.

scripts.pretest: npm run compile && npm run lint
scripts.test:all: npm run test:cov && npm run test:integration
